archetypes.name: Storybook Cover
archetypes.description: A wistful children's-book cover: watercolor washes, golden light, and a deep old forest behind your subject.
effects: Equips five style cards across Canvas, Illumination, Universe, References, and Execution
Sets the tail preset to portrait 2:3 at stylize 250
Leaves your subject line untouched

archetypes.name: Neon Noir
archetypes.description: A rain-soaked electric night: neon saturation, living glow, and a tight cinematic portrait crop.
effects: Equips four cards across Tone, Universe, Illumination, and Execution
Pushes Intensity to Extreme so every card goes loud
Sets the tail preset to wide 16:9, stylize 400, chaos 10

archetypes.name: Epic Fantasy Cover
archetypes.description: A storm-lit book cover in iron and jewel tones: grimdark drama shot from the ground looking up.
effects: Stacks two References with storm light, jewel tones, and two framing cards
Runs at Extreme intensity for full theatrical drama
Sets the tail preset to portrait 2:3 at stylize 500

archetypes.name: Cozy Storybook
archetypes.description: A soft pastel picture-book page: watercolor, gray-day light, and a warm cluttered room around your subject.
effects: Equips five gentle cards across every softness lever the deck has
Keeps Intensity at Bold so the charm stays legible
Sets the tail preset to social 4:5 at stylize 250

archetypes.name: Cyber Portrait
archetypes.description: A tight face-first frame in a neon megacity: sign-glow lighting, film grade, and hard contrast.
effects: Builds the classic cyberpunk close-up from five cards
Runs at Extreme so the neon floods and the contrast splits
Sets the tail preset to portrait 2:3, stylize 400, chaos 15

archetypes.name: Studio Product
archetypes.description: A clean commercial setup: softbox light, centered symmetry, generous emptiness, honest film texture.
effects: Equips the four cards of a controlled studio catalog shot
Runs at Subtle so nothing upstages the subject
Sets the tail preset to square 1:1 at stylize 100

archetypes.name: Ghost Story
archetypes.description: A Victorian haunting in silver and black: a spectral figure, moonlight, and gaslit fog.
effects: Adds a spectral co-star beside your subject
Builds the haunting from moonlight, noir values, and gothic fog
Sets the tail preset to social 4:5

archetypes.name: Plein Air
archetypes.description: An easel in a field at golden hour: broken impressionist color over honest earth tones.
effects: Equips the four cards of an outdoor light study
Keeps Intensity at Bold for confident daubs without dissolving form
Sets the tail preset to photo 3:2

archetypes.name: Retro Sprite
archetypes.description: A candy-colored pixel hero shot: 16-bit rendering, loud palette, and a look-up frame in deep space.
effects: Builds a game-splash pixel scene from four cards
Runs at Bold so the pixels stay detailed, not chunky
Sets the tail preset to square 1:1

archetypes.name: Wildlife Lens
archetypes.description: A patient telephoto hide: film grain, creamy bokeh, gray-sky light, and thin mountain air.
effects: Equips the five cards of a field-photography kit
Keeps color honest and the background melted
Sets the tail preset to wide 16:9

archetypes.name: Dream Drift
archetypes.description: A lucid dream at full volume: surreal logic, opal color, floating islands, and doubled exposures.
effects: Stacks five reality-bending cards at Extreme intensity
Adds weird 1000 to let the model wander
Sets the tail preset to wide 16:9

archetypes.name: Gilded Arcana
archetypes.description: A tarot plate in leaded glass: centered symbolism, flowing nouveau line, and jewel-toned light.
effects: Stacks tarot symbolism with art nouveau line in stained glass
Centers the composition like a true arcana plate
Sets the tail preset to portrait 2:3 at stylize 600

archetypes.name: Deco Metropolis
archetypes.description: A gilded skyline from above: deco geometry, travel-poster optimism, and hard graphic contrast.
effects: Pairs deco geometry with travel-poster flats
Looks straight down for a skyline-as-pattern frame
Sets the tail preset to portrait 2:3

archetypes.name: Clay Mascot
archetypes.description: A friendly squashable character turnaround: clay render, pastel sweetness, studio light, dead center.
effects: Builds a toy-shelf mascot setup from four cards
Runs at Subtle so the clay stays cute, not smeared
Sets the tail preset to square 1:1

archetypes.name: Cinema Frame
archetypes.description: One frame from a thriller: rim-lit figures, steel palette, thirds framing, and melted background.
effects: Builds a graded thriller still from five cards
Frames on thirds with a razor focal plane
Sets the tail preset to cinema 21:9 at stylize 200

archetypes.name: Woodblock Journey
archetypes.description: A traveler's print: ukiyo-e planes, muted inks, and mountain country in a wide frame.
effects: Builds a woodblock landscape print from four cards
Keeps the palette muted like aged inks
Sets the tail preset to photo 3:2

archetypes.name: Field Journal
archetypes.description: A naturalist's page: botanical precision in ink, sun-faded paper, and specimens laid out at right angles.
effects: Builds an antique field-journal plate from four cards
Runs at Subtle so the linework stays scientific
Sets the tail preset to social 4:5

archetypes.name: Anime Quest
archetypes.description: A key visual for an adventure that doesn't exist: cel shading, a young hero, sky islands, and god rays.
effects: Casts a spirited young hero beside your subject
Builds the adventure from cel shading, sky islands, and god rays
Sets the tail preset to wide 16:9 at stylize 300
